summary: Both backend regression scripts (manual_alert_digest_gallery.py and manual_typed_params.py) pass end-to-end. Frontend Alert Digest card on /maintenance-status and Photo Gallery inside the Equipment Master maintenance-profile dialog for a newly-created 'ZZ GAL pump' were fully verified: the digest shows '2 flag(s) on 1 record(s)', renders the amber Pressure pill and rose 'Condition: Leaking' pill with camera+1, Send button flips summary to 'Digest sent …', an empty date disables Send, and the gallery reports (1 photo), filters (Inspection → 0 with empty-state text; back to All → 1), lightbox opens/closes on click, and 'Download all (ZIP)' streams a .zip containing the JPEG plus manifest.csv with the expected columns/values. Test data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: MaintenanceProfile dialog raises a React a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Non-blocking but should be addressed by adding a DialogDescription.
seed_data_creation: Created ZZ GAL pump + 1 param photo + 1 pre-production maintenance record (2 out-of-range flags) on 2026-09-13. Cleaned up equipment, records, photos, notifications and maintenance_alert_digest docs after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Alert Digest + Photo Gallery features are stable. Note: gallery-kind is a native <select> whose 'All photos' option uses value="" (not 'all'). MaintenanceProfile dialog is opened via the row kebab menu -> data-testid=eq-maint-profile-<name-with-dashes>, not from the icon buttons directly on the row.
